sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Loading the solar import records
sections.what: Reads the four saved record files that describe the commit, the verification and the corrections.
sections.why: Likely reason: the page is built from these saved records rather than the live database, so it reflects what was recorded.
sections.watch_out: A missing or renamed file stops the script before the page is written.

sections.name: esc
sections.title: Building the audit page
sections.what: Builds one section per committed project showing its identity, field changes, quotes marked as live-checked or uploaded, participants, milestones and held facts. It then adds the summary, correction notes and excluded candidates, and writes the page.
sections.why: Likely reason: recording each correction in the page lets a reviewer trace every change.
sections.watch_out: The summary sentences carry fixed counts such as eight inserted projects, so they must be edited by hand when the data changes.

summary: Builds the final HTML audit page for the solar import, listing each inserted, enriched or held project with its quotes, sources and changes.
purpose: It gives a reviewer one complete record of the solar import, including every quote and what was changed.
why: Likely reason: a readable final audit record that can be opened without the database.
how: It reads four saved record files, then builds one section per committed project covering identity, field changes, quotes with their source type, participants, milestones and held facts. It adds a summary, correction notes and the excluded candidates, and writes the page.
inputs: committed.json, verification.json, source-scope-correction.json and field-source-correction.json in artifacts/api-server/data/solar-report, plus the solar manifest module.
risks: The summary counts and dates are typed directly into the page text, so they will be wrong if the data changes and this script is not updated.
debug: A missing file error means one of the four record names is wrong. If the counts on the page differ from the committed file, compare them with the committed data. A project with no quotes usually means its manifest entries are missing.
